screening_decisions.reason: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot testing intracervical nitroprusside prior to IUD; primary outcome was self-reported pain with IUD insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.

Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled ibuprofen vs placebo given before IUD; measured self-reported pain immediately after insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.
Randomized trial of full bladder vs empty before IUC insertion; included women’s self-reported pain scores during insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.

Open-label randomized trial comparing 2% intracervical lidocaine vs ibuprofen; assessed self-reported pain immediately, 2 h, and 6 h post-insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.

Double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT of 800 mg ibuprofen vs placebo prior to LNG-IUS; measured self-reported pain at tenaculum and during insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.
Double-blind RCT of vaginal misoprostol vs placebo 3 h before IUD; assessed insertion-related pain (no difference). Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.

Randomized trial of buccal misoprostol vs placebo; measured self-reported pain at multiple time points including tenaculum and IUD insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.
Double-blind RCT in repeat LNG-IUS insertions (misoprostol vs placebo); recorded patient-reported pain at insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.
Large double-blind RCT of 400 mg ibuprofen vs placebo in first-time IUD users; measured self-reported pain immediately after insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.

Randomized trial of misoprostol aimed at facilitating insertion; outcomes were failed insertion, ease, complications, and satisfaction; no patient-reported insertion pain outcomes described. Excluded per selection criteria.

Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled ibuprofen vs placebo; assessed pain during insertion and within the first 4–6 hours after insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.
Randomized, double-blind, three-arm (tramadol, naproxen, placebo) trial; evaluated self-reported pain during IUD insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.
Double-blind RCT of buccal misoprostol vs placebo in nulliparous women; collected VAS pain scores including at IUD insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.

Randomized, double-blind clinical trial of intracervical 2% lidocaine gel vs placebo; measured self-reported pain at multiple time points including insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.

Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot of vaginal nitroglycerin prior to LNG-IUS; primary outcome was self-reported pain with passage/deployment. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.

Randomized trial of 1% lidocaine paracervical block vs no anesthetic; measured self-reported pain at tenaculum, insertion, and 5 minutes post-procedure. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.

Randomized, double-blind controlled trial of 2% lidocaine gel vs lubricant vs no intervention; assessed self-reported pain during insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.
Randomized, double-blind pilot of intrauterine 2% lidocaine vs saline; measured self-reported pain at tenaculum and during insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.

Randomized trial of sublingual misoprostol + diclofenac vs diclofenac; measured insertion ease and self-reported pain (VAS) with IUD insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.

Randomized, double-blind trial of vaginal misoprostol vs placebo in nulligravidas; reported reduced moderate-to-severe self-reported pain at insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.
Randomized block trial of lavender aromatherapy vs placebo before IUD; measured self-reported pain after insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.

Double-blind RCT of self-administered misoprostol vs placebo in nulliparous women; measured self-reported pain before and after IUD insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.
Randomized, placebo-controlled phase-II trial of a novel topical lidocaine formulation; demonstrated reduced self-reported insertion pain. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.
Prospective single-blinded controlled study with paracervical block vs placebo vs no treatment; randomization not stated; likely non-randomized. Excluded per selection criteria.
Randomized clinical trial of misoprostol vs placebo in nulliparous women; primary outcome was self-reported pain at insertion (VAS). Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.

Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of self-administered vaginal 2% lidocaine vs placebo; assessed change in self-reported pain at insertion. Meets RCT and pain outcome criteria; comparator acceptable.
